item.tib: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus las drag po las kyi kha tshar du bsad pa spu gri reg chod
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro dgongs pa kun 'dus drag po las kyi kha tshar bsad pa spu gri reg chod 'di ni chos bdag slob ma rnams kyis nan cher bskul ba dang / sangs rgyas g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir du/ shar rong rnam dag bkod pa'i ngo mtshar nor bu'i gling du/ kho bo kun grol grags pas me 'brug zla ba dgu pa'i tshes la/ sug bris su bgyis pa dge legs dar rgyas su gyur cig
